messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: P0 alert — generation APIs returning 5xx and timeouts in us-west and eu-west. Affects text-generation and streaming. Auto-retries enabled; fallback to smaller model attempted but observed higher latencies. Pager sent to @eng-oncall. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/generation-outages>
maria: seeing broad 5xx spikes on the gateway graphs. request rate normal, error rate up ~12% for gen endpoints. This looks like upstream model servers failing rather than authentication.
ashok: acked. switching to incident mode. oncall handover — @eng-oncall you're primary. tagging @pm-lex for customer comms. severity set to P0. Can someone confirm impact surface (hosted vs dedicated vs private)?
eng-oncall: on it. quick check: dedicated instances show no 5xx, but hosted pool in us-west is exhibiting retries and 502s from model-backend-3. eu-west shows similar pattern but fewer instances. Starting kill/restart on model-backend-3. Will capture logs.
oliver: dbg logs show repeated exceptions in the model loader: "OOM while allocating KV cache" on several GPUs followed by process exit. Could be a recent quantization change or a bad model rollout.
maria: rolling alerts into the incident channel. Can we draft a status page initial update? Need high-level customer-facing wording + ETA for next update. Suggest: "We’re investigating elevated errors and timeouts affecting text generation in US and EU regions. Some requests may see errors or increased latency."
pm-lex: agree with that wording. Add we’re prioritizing hosted customers; dedicated deployments unaffected. Also mention mitigations in progress. I can review short user-facing draft.
eng-oncall: mitigation steps: 1) cordon problem instances 2) restart model processes 3) fallback routing to healthy pool (lower-capacity). Implementing fallback now. If fallbacks hold, we can reduce customer impact but latency will increase.
ashok: legal, are there any required phrases for GDPR-regulated customers re: incident notifications? @legal
legal: quick note — avoid implying data loss. Use neutral language: "We observed elevated errors and timeouts; your data is not suspected to be compromised." We can sign off on the draft once PM approves.
sarah-se: tagging support — include the list of affected features: streaming, synchronous generation, and tool-calling. Embeddings and vector search not impacted.
maria: draft statuspage copy (proposed). Please review inline and react with :thumbsup: when ready.

--- DRAFT START ---
We’re investigating elevated errors and timeouts affecting text generation in US and EU regions. Some hosted requests may return errors (5xx) or take longer to complete. Dedicated deployments are not affected. Our engineering team is actively restarting impacted model servers and routing traffic to healthy pools as a mitigation.
Next update: in 15 minutes or sooner if we have a significant change.
--- DRAFT END ---

pm-lex: small suggestion — add customer impact bullet: "Customers may see failures or slower responses for generation and streaming APIs; token usage may be impacted during retries." Otherwise +1.
eng-oncall: pushed fallback routing for ~60% of traffic in us-west; error rate dropped from 12% -> 6% in the last 2 minutes. Still seeing 502 spikes from one backend.
oliver: adding note — recent deploy rolled a model package with a new KV cache config 45m ago. I'm rolling that change back on the affected hosts now.
maria: Legal happy with the current phrasing (thanks). PM lex please confirm final copy so ops can publish.
pm-lex: approved. small tweak: change "Next update: in 15 minutes" -> "Next update: 15 minutes" then publish.
ops-publish-bot: queued statuspage update. Preview: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/preview/2234500000 (ops only). To publish run: `statusctl publish 2234500000 --message-file draft.txt --visibility public`
eng-oncall: rolling restart finished on 3/4 hosts; one host failed to come up due to CUDA driver mismatch. We'll reprovision a clean instance. Error rate steady at ~4% after fallback.
maria: publish now. ops-publish-bot please proceed.
ops-publish-bot: published initial update at 2234500060. Notifying customers via email subset (hosted customers with >1000 requests/day). Logged message id: sp-2234500060.
ashok: good. Plan for cadence: 15m updates until steady-state under 1% errors, then 30m updates. Track customer-impacting SLAs and escalate if errors persist.
eng-oncall: deploying reprovision for the CUDA mismatch host. ETA ~20min for reimage and warmed model. If reconverges we'll route traffic back.
pm-lex: support: prepping customer templates for high-usage customers. Suggested customer message snippet: "We experienced elevated errors and timeouts for text generation in US and EU regions between 15:12 - ongoing; we are routing traffic to healthy pools. We will follow up when the issue is resolved and provide a root cause analysis." Feedback?
sarah-se: template OK. Add "Workaround" section: instruct customers to retry and enable client-side exponential backoff. Link to SDK retry docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/retries
oliver: host came back healthy after reprovision. error rate dropped to ~0.8%. Continuing monitoring.
maria: publishing update (recovery + partial mitigation). ops-publish-bot please post the 15m update.
ops-publish-bot: published update at 2234500180. Content: "Mitigation in progress — traffic routed to healthy pools; error rates improving. Some hosted requests may still see intermittent errors or higher latency. Next update: 30 minutes or sooner." Notifying affected customers.
pm-lex: pushing customer email now. Support to copy the status page link in replies.
eng-oncall: monitoring for 10 more minutes. If stable, prepare resolved notice and brief RCA summary.
maria: all hands — please prepare short RCA bullet points for post-incident: root cause (KV cache config introduced in deploy), contributing factors (no canary on large sequence lengths), mitigation steps (rollback, reprovision, fallback routing), and next actions (add automated canary + improve deploy gating + alert runbook update).
legal: no further comments. Good to include "no data exposure detected" in resolved notice.
ops-publish-bot: statuspage resolved notice queued. Draft resolved copy: "Resolved — service restored for text generation in US and EU regions. The issue was caused by a model deployment that introduced an incompatible KV cache setting, leading to OOMs on some model servers. We rolled back the change and reprovisioned affected hosts. There is no indication of data loss or compromise. Full RCA to follow." Ready to publish on approval.
pm-lex: approved. publish resolved when error rate holds <1% for 15 minutes.
eng-oncall: holding for 15m. current error rate 0.6% and latency back to normal. Will post final resolve at T+15.
ops-publish-bot: published resolved notice at 2234500420. Notified customers and internal channels. Postmortem: tracking to eng-postmortems/2234500000. Thanks team. :tada:
